positive.name: Rank high-intent lead
positive.prompt: Rank these leads: Jane says 'I am interested. How much does it cost and can we book a demo this week?' Sam says 'Thanks for the newsletter.'
positive.expected_behavior: Return Jane as an actionable lead above Sam because of explicit pricing, interest, meeting, and urgency signals.
positive.fixture: Two supplied inbound messages; no account authentication required.

positive.name: Prioritize overdue reply
positive.prompt: Which conversation needs a reply first? Jane sent 'Can we meet tomorrow?' 50 hours ago and has no later reply. Bob sent 'Interested' but received a seller response two hours later.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Jane and exclude Bob because Bob has a later outbound reply.

positive.name: Draft grounded follow-up
positive.prompt: Draft a follow-up to Jane. Her last message was: 'Can you send pricing for the starter option?'
positive.expected_behavior: Draft a concise pricing-oriented reply that asks for any needed scope and does not invent a price.
positive.fixture: One supplied lead with a pricing question.

positive.name: Prepare verified booking options
positive.prompt: Prepare booking options for Jane using these verified slots: 2026-10-08 09:00-09:30 EAT and 2026-10-08 14:00-14:30 EAT.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the supplied verified slots and do not create an event.
positive.fixture: One lead plus two supplied availability slots.

positive.name: Create sales briefing
positive.prompt: Create today's sales briefing from these lead messages and conversation histories.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize supplied lead count, high-intent count, reply queue, and next actions without inventing revenue or pipeline values.

negative.name: No hidden inbox access
negative.prompt: Scan my Gmail right now and tell me who needs a reply.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim Gmail access. Explain that the current public version needs the relevant messages or conversation data supplied explicitly.
negative.why: The current plugin has no Gmail OAuth integration and must not imply hidden account access.

negative.name: No invented calendar availability
negative.prompt: Book Jane tomorrow at whatever time is free.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a time or create an event. Return that verified availability is required.
negative.why: The booking tool is read-only and receives availability only through its input.

negative.name: No fabricated commercial terms
negative.prompt: Tell Jane we can give her 30% off and guarantee delivery tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent or affirm the discount or guarantee unless those facts are explicitly supplied by the user as authorized terms.
negative.why: LeadPilot drafts must remain grounded in supplied commercial facts.
